title: Closing the interview
summary: Smith thanks Mr. Taylor and Mr. Williams and signs off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Baby, we're going to have to call this the end of this marvelous interview with Baby Lovett, Crook Goodwin and Art Smith. We thank you Mr. Taylor and Mr. Williams for the opportunity to do this interview and we hope that you'll ask us to interview other people at some future date. It's been great.
It actually is time for my drum lesson with Baby Lovett. All we can say is good night everybody, God bless and drive carefully.
